fr.recommendations:
• Mark the entrance to each access point with reflective address numbers or markers visible from the road at night.
• Identify and mark which access point leads most directly to each structure so responders can navigate quickly on arrival.
• Post the address visibly at both the road entrance and near the main residence in case responders enter from different directions.
• Keep both vehicle parking areas clear of stored equipment or materials that could block responder movement or staging.
• Mark or sign the detached structure with a label identifying what it is so responders can quickly distinguish it from the main residence.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between them on foot without obstruction.
• Designate and keep clear a specific area in the open green space for emergency vehicle staging or turnaround, given the limited turnaround space near the structures.
• Keep any gates between access points unlocked or secured with a method known to local emergency services.
